title: Testing Result with Messages
goal: Assert on Result values while providing descriptive failure messages.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unit Tests

hints: find returns Result<i32, &'static str>, so comparisons must match the Result wrapper.
assert_eq! accepts custom message string literals after the expected value.
explanation: `find(1)` returns `Result<i32, &'static str>`, so comparing it directly to integer `10` or `Some(10)` produces compiler error `E0308` due to mismatched types. `assert!(find(2).is_ok())` compiles but fails at runtime because `find(2)` returns `Err("not found")`. `assert_eq!(find(1), Ok(10), ...)` and `assert_eq!(find(2), Err("not found"), ...)` correctly match both variants.
